prediction_agent.headline: Goal: Build €1m of wealth by age 41. With your current habits the chance of reaching it is 40%.
prediction_agent.if_nothing_changes: If nothing changes, your wealth can end between €301k – €2.91m (middle €778k), and the chance of ending below today is 27%.

future_selves.same_habits: With the same habits, your goal 'Build €1m of wealth by age 41' has a 40% chance.
future_selves.with_changes: With 'Do all of the above', you face the same futures with more room to decide.

what_it_means: If your income stopped tomorrow, your cash would cover 1.1 months of your bills.
In a middle future, 'Diversify the family company shares' leaves you about €148k more at 41, which is 4.4 years of your current spending.
In a middle future, 'Do all of the above' leaves you about €382k more at 41, which is 11.3 years of your current spending.

best_change.why: Of the single changes, 'Diversify the family company shares' does most for this goal: 46% instead of 40% (+6 points).
best_change.first_step: Book the family-table session with your advisor and your parents to agree a step-by-step plan.

goals.sentence: Build €1m of wealth by age 41: 40% with same habits, 46% with 'Diversify the family company shares'.

watch_out.sentence: A market fall of 15% or more in which you sell and miss the rebound: 71% chance with same habits. With 'Hold by written rule in a crash' it falls to 0% in the simulation.

prediction_agent.trade_off: The best futures are less high with: Diversify the family company shares. That is the cost of spreading risk.

comparison.what_happens: Save €400 a month into a buffer: goal 45%, below today 19%.
Invest €150 a month: goal 42%, below today 24%.
Hold by written rule in a crash: goal 41%, below today 25%. Panic sale: 0% in the simulation.
Diversify the family company shares: goal 46%, below today 17%. Company shock: reduced.
Get disability cover: goal 40%, below today 27%. Year without income: 0% in the simulation.
Do all of the above: goal 59%, below today 6%. Company shock: reduced. Panic sale: 0% in the simulation. Year without income: 0% in the simulation.

prediction_agent.disclaimer: Simulated range on stated assumptions, not a promise.

action_agent.intro: Your goal: Build €1m of wealth by age 41, 40% chance today. The quick wins free €308 a month and set aside €400 a month. Quick wins first, then one advisor conversation.

actions.title: Start a buffer: €400 a month
actions.why: Buffer today: 1.1 months of spending. Effect on your goal: +5 points. That is €72k saved over 15 years (buffer first, then investments).
actions.how: Confirm the prepared standing order: €400 on the 1st of each month into a new emergency pot. Once it covers 3 months of spending (after about 14 months), the €400 goes to your investments instead.
actions.verified_by: Bank data: the standing order ran

impact.over_horizon: €72k saved over 15 years (buffer first, then investments)

actions.title: Put the new car on hold
actions.why: New car: €38,000 planned in 6 months. Buying now would lower your goal chance to 36%; waiting keeps it at 40%.
actions.how: Wait until your buffer covers 3 months of spending, and talk it through with your advisor before signing a loan.
actions.verified_by: Bank data: no loan contract and a buffer above 3 months

actions.title: Set a €200 monthly limit for eating out
actions.why: Eating out: €430 a month, people like you spend about €160. Effect on your goal: +3 points. That is €41k freed over 15 years.
actions.how: Set a €200 limit in the app. You get a nudge at 80% of it, and whatever you do not spend under the limit moves into your savings.
actions.verified_by: Bank data: two months at or below the limit

actions.title: Cancel what you no longer use (€78 a month)
actions.why: You pay €78 a month for Gym premium and Car-sharing plus, which you no longer use. It protects you rather than clearly raising the goal chance. That is €14k freed over 15 years.
actions.how: Cancel Gym premium and Car-sharing plus in the app's subscription view. The freed €78 a month moves into your savings automatically.

actions.title: Write your will with the guided checklist
actions.why: €402k of family company shares would pass on without a will. It protects you rather than clearly raising the goal chance.
actions.how: Answer the 12-question checklist in the app, then book a notary and upload the signed will.

actions.title: Agree a step-by-step plan to lower your single-company share
actions.why: 82% of your wealth is in the family company shares. Effect on your goal: +6 points.
actions.how: Book the family-table session with your advisor and your parents to agree a step-by-step plan.
actions.verified_by: Advisor confirmed: plan agreed and first step taken

risks.label: The family company loses 40% or more in a single year

risks.typical_hit_here: 26% of your total wealth in that year

impact.company_shock_hit_after: 26% of your total wealth in that year

actions.title: Write down your rules for falling markets
actions.why: You sold everything in the crash test. It protects you rather than clearly raising the goal chance.
actions.how: Write down your rules for a falling market with your advisor, then practise them in the crash review.
actions.verified_by: Advisor confirmed, then passed again in the crash review

actions.title: Agree a monthly investment plan of about €150
actions.why: You save €180 a month, 6% of income. Effect on your goal: +2 points. That is €27k saved over 15 years.
actions.how: Confirm the save-more-tomorrow commitment: half of your next raise goes into your monthly investment plan.
actions.verified_by: Bank data: the plan received its first payment

advisor_meeting.sentence: One meeting with your advisor covers: agree a step-by-step plan to lower your single-company share; write down your rules for falling markets; agree a monthly investment plan of about €150.

action_agent.disclaimer: Educational guidance, not investment advice. Decisions about investments are made with your advisor after a suitability check.
